claims.summary: The release does not claim 100/100; it targets a deterministic source-ledger bridge loss from the current quality target.
Source-finder mini-shard recovery now preserves up to two trusted, concept-linked rows from one retrieved topic instead of collapsing to one row.
Open Library public metadata remains excluded from trusted proof when stronger OpenAlex/Crossref rows are available.
The source-ledger summary counts both recovered rows as trusted concept-linked proof only when they satisfy the strict row predicate.
